title: ID0442065-DC/SI-D/FR-[Y2/PN 312562229/08]Charging on connector 1 is not possible
description:
Reported issue:
Charging on connector 1 is not possible. The charging steps never
validate, even after several attempts.
I tried to charge on this connector without success on 05/08/2025
at 12:47 PM (French time).
